confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Florianópolis pricing, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable. Accommodation anchors are less certain because they vary with season, neighbourhood and booking lead time; July is Brazil's mid-year school-holiday period with moderate tourist demand. Cocktail and wine anchors use beer as the local price reference, since direct knowledge of those venue prices is weaker. The FX observation comes from an RBA exchange-rates page surfaced in search results and was not independently re-opened on the page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Brazilian coastal tourist cities of similar scale and visitor profile (for example, other southern Brazilian beach and resort cities), adjusted to Florianópolis' local pricing.
